photos.description: View of the station house of the New Dorp Staten Island Railway station as seen from the Tottenville -bound platform in the New Dorp section of Staten Island, New York City . The Saint George Terminal -bound platform on the right also has a staircase leading to the station house. Though the station house is similar to many others from the PWA -funded and B&O influenced grade elimination projects of the 1930's, it was actually built in the late-1960's when B&O merged with C&O and WM to form the Chessie System Railroad, and was trying to dispose of subsidiaries like the Staten Island Rapid Trans
